notes: Define sensor model serial settings register scale and cable

acceptance_criteria: Known headings map to correct degrees or directions
method: Rotate to controlled compass headings
notes: Repository evidence needed despite reported prior success

acceptance_criteria: New ID persists after power cycle and does not collide with second sensor
method: Address tool plus two-device bus test
notes: Document recovery from duplicate IDs

acceptance_criteria: Module is detected and data fields are readable
method: Bench diagnostic
notes: No-fix is not the same as communication failure

acceptance_criteria: Valid UTC date/time and non-zero position outdoors
method: Outdoor sky-view acquisition test
notes: Record time-to-first-fix and power policy

acceptance_criteria: Output changes monotonically under controlled UV exposure and calibration is stored
method: Controlled source/comparison test
notes: Baseline UV sensor and optical path not selected

acceptance_criteria: ESP32 runs from documented solar-manager and battery path
method: Voltage/current and interruption/recovery test
notes: Document dedicated 5 V output and protection

acceptance_criteria: Complete-system sleep and active-state currents are documented

notes: Include network sensor GNSS and fault states

acceptance_criteria: Measured runtime meets or exceeds the approved engineering target
method: Charged battery endurance test
notes: Three-day value is a planning target until confirmed

acceptance_criteria: 20 open-close cycles without latch damage or loss of fit
method: Repeated assembly inspection
notes: Record CAD and material revision

acceptance_criteria: No water reaches protected electronics after defined unpowered spray test
method: Unpowered controlled exposure
notes: No formal IP rating claim

acceptance_criteria: Local data collection continues and reconnect succeeds without reset loop
method: Forced outage during logging
notes: Local-first buffering required

acceptance_criteria: No unexplained resets bus lockups severe sensor anomalies loose wiring enclosure leak or corrupted data

notes: Tracked by Issue #6

acceptance_criteria: Automatic core evidence is recorded and at least one human observation per test day checks plausibility power enclosure mounting cables and weather risk

acceptance_criteria: Physical inspection and data summary identify ingress condensation corrosion connector or mounting change contamination final battery state completeness restarts outages recovery and next action
method: Controlled de-energised inspection plus log analysis
evidence: Photos where permitted inspection record metrics and decision
notes: Escalate battery electrical or severe-ingress hazards to competent staff

acceptance_criteria: Each priority variable has a documented reference hierarchy method specification and project tolerance; repeated differences beyond manufacturer specification are investigated and unstable post-calibration sensing is replaced or its claim narrowed
method: Co-location or handheld spot checks plus contextual trend/range analysis
evidence: Reference metadata raw comparison calibration decision and uncertainty note

acceptance_criteria: The release states the next-test-only meaning of 72 hours selects buy/borrow versus build from the real objective and contains no unsupported carbon ESG commercial-grade or reliability claim
method: Independent review against VAL-001 and Gate E decision
evidence: Reviewed claim checklist strategy record and linked evidence
notes: Revisit after Gate E and whenever a sustainability impact claim is added

acceptance_criteria: A TA can complete and explain the quick checklist classify scenarios follow escalation and record actual task times without instructor coaching

test_name: Candidate mounting public-risk and security comparison

test_name: Candidate exposure network and reference characterisation
